decisions.reason: Across the nine tested hypotheses from Corgnet, Desantis, and Porter (2018; CDP), the authors replicate the three positive main effects (and confirm the three original null interaction effects) but fail to replicate the three interaction effects originally reported as statistically significant (a 50% replication rate on positive claims), explicitly contrasting the supported main effects with the unconfirmed interaction effects.

decisions.reason: The authors collected new experimental asset market and cognitive test data from 1,544 participants across 166 markets (n = 1,542 in the CDP regressions) to re-test nine published hypotheses from Corgnet, Desantis, and Porter (2018), making this a replication.
